news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: Simon Willison 发布 llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1，修复因 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 而导致未直接依赖 httpx 的插件失效的问题。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这体现了底层 HTTP 客户端变更对插件生态的连带影响，以及维护者快速修补兼容性的必要性。
news.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1, fixing breakage caused when LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2 and plugins used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows how an underlying HTTP client change can ripple through a plugin ecosystem and why maintainers need to patch compatibility quickly.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 0.5 发布；该调试插件提供一个不涉及 LLM、只回显输入提示的“模型”，新版更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用和系统提示等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这有助于开发者在不调用真实模型的情况下测试提示与 token 统计逻辑。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 is released; the debug plugin provides a “model” that does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts, and the new version updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and related factors.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test prompt and token-counting logic without calling a real model.

news.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

news.summary_zh: 这些代理通过应用配置、公共代码仓库中暴露的凭证和连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色进入系统。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 事件凸显 AI 代理安全与云凭证、权限配置管理之间的关联。
news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights the link between AI agent security and the management of cloud credentials and permissions.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 投资物理 AI 的英伟达资深人士称，物理 AI 不只是机器人
news.summary_zh: 曾领导英伟达机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人技术正处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这提供了对物理 AI 成熟度与投资节奏的不同判断，强调基础组件仍待完善。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in a “Lego era,” with building blocks such as actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.
news.why_it_matters_en: It offers a different view on the maturity and investment pace of physical AI, stressing that foundational components still need work.

news.title_en: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
news.summary_en: According to Elorian’s evaluations, Glimpse outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

top5.title_zh: Elorian 首个模型 Glimpse：对图像本身做推理

top5.what_zh: Elorian 发布首个模型 Glimpse，主打对图像本身推理而非仅描述图像；据公司自评，其在科学图表推理和短视频字幕任务上优于 GPT-6 Astra，其他视觉推理任务表现相当。

top5.why_zh: 若图表与视频推理能力成立，将改变文档解析、科研辅助与内容审核类产品的能力边界。
top5.why_en: If the chart and video reasoning claims hold, they move the capability baseline for document parsing, research assistance and content moderation products.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 全部数据为厂商自评，缺乏第三方复现，应作为方向信号而非定论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: All figures are vendor-reported with no independent replication; treat this as a directional signal, not a settled result.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：视觉推理成为新的差异化赛道；风险：自评基准易夸大，选型必须自测。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: visual reasoning as a fresh differentiation axis; risk: self-reported benchmarks can overstate, so validate before adoption.
top5.action_zh: 先阅读原文核对评测方法，再用自己的图表与视频样本做小规模对比测试。
top5.action_en: Read the source to check the evaluation methodology, then run a small comparison on your own chart and video samples.

top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：凭据与权限治理需求上升；风险：智能体会放大既有的配置疏忽。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: rising demand for credential and permission hygiene; risk: agents amplify pre-existing misconfigurations.
top5.action_zh: 审计自有仓库与云角色中的暴露凭据并收紧权限，同时阅读原文了解细节。
top5.action_en: Audit your repositories and cloud roles for exposed credentials and tighten permissions, and read the source for details.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

editorial.core_zh: 今天的重点不在单一模型分数，而在整合、治理与安全：人才与资产向内容平台集中，厂商用股权与治理平台回应外部性，而事故入口往往来自最基础的凭据配置。
editorial.core_en: Today's signal is less about a single model score than about consolidation, governance and security: talent and assets moving toward content platforms, labs answering externalities with equity and governance layers, and incidents entering through basic credential configuration.
editorial.trend_zh: 竞争重心从模型榜单转向组织结构与治理安排，同时配置类基础风险成为智能体落地的主要事故来源。
editorial.trend_en: Competitive focus is shifting from leaderboards to organizational structure and governance, while basic configuration risk becomes the main failure source in agent deployments.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当厂商自评与治理承诺都难以独立验证时，团队应建立哪些自测与审计指标来支撑采购与部署决策？
editorial.next_question_en: When vendor self-evaluations and governance pledges cannot be independently verified, which self-testing and audit metrics should teams use to justify procurement and deployment decisions?
